audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer named three abilities Aurelion Sol does not have: 'comet orbit' (spikes[2], early), 'Starsurge' (spikes[0], wants.you[1]) and 'Voice of Light' (spikes[1], wants.foe[0]). These are his pre-rework kit. His actual abilities are Cosmic Creator, Breath of Light, Astral Flight, Singularity and Falling Star / The Skies Descend. packet.defects also flags that the page never names any of them.
audit.why: A reader looking for 'Starsurge' on their screen will not find it. This is the exact defect class the calibration list was built from.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one and the surrounding advice rebuilt on the real mechanic: Breath of Light is a 750-range channel on 3s, Astral Flight is his only exit at 22s->16s, Singularity is a 12s black hole that executes at its centre, Falling Star is a 1250-range stun on 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: content mid called Falling Star 'a global teleport/damage tool'. It is a 1250-range stun on 120/110/100. content late credited Diana with 'true damage' — nothing in her kit deals true damage.
audit.why: Both claims would change how a player plays the level 6 window and the late-game duel.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten around the real 1250-range stun; late rewritten without the true-damage claim.
sources: ownerKit — no trueDamage flag on any ability

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill/Diana/Diana/Skill/Diana/Skill/Aurelion Sol while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart are Diana on all seven rows. phases[6] handed the last row to Aurelion Sol while its own why described Diana diving and the content layer said Diana.
audit.why: He has no dash or blink other than a 22s Astral Flight, and Diana closes 825 with a resetting dash; the 53.16% across 649 games and the unanimous packet chart agree.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [3], [5] and [6].side set to Diana; phases[0], [2] and [3].why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 2 Astral Flight, level 3 Lunar Rush, level 6 Moonfall, first item, then his Stardust scaling. Cosmic Creator permanently improves his abilities as he stacks Stardust, which is why the lane wants to be ended early.
audit.corrected: spikes[] rebuilt on real ability names and real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity's execute was absent — 'the center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain p[ercent]'.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'execute-threshold': you have to track the HP number, not the bar. Diana dives into that black hole every time she commits.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.mid, loading, dontsFull[2].d and content late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Astral Flight 22s->16s, Breath of Light 3s, Singularity 12s, Falling Star 120s, Pale Cascade 15s.

edits.after: Survive Breath of Light one crescent at a time, then commit while Astral Flight is on 22s — without it he cannot leave.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by kiting on Astral Flight, stacking Stardust off Breath of Light, and executing you in Singularity.

edits.after: - Diana vs Aurelion Sol - Astral Flight is 22s — that is your window. - Dash only onto Moonlight marks. - Never sit low in Singularity; the centre executes. - Moonfall closes arguments.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by catching him with Astral Flight spent — no dash, no blink, and 16s before he can leave again.

edits.after: You are the dive: E onto the Moonlight mark past the front line, R the collapse, and focus the man with no escape.

edits.after: Your Q-AA-E pressure punishes an immobile caster whose only exit, Astral Flight, is still on a 22-second cooldown.

edits.after: Moonfall lands at 6 against a champion with no blink — Astral Flight is his only disengage and it is a 22s cooldown.

edits.after: Riftmaker or Shadowflame burst kills him well before Breath of Light channels long enough to trade back.

edits.before: This lane is miserable for Aurelion Sol from level 1 — his comet orbit needs setup time and range to poke safely, but Diana's dash-in kit closes that gap instantly and punishes his near-zero mobility. Through levels 3-5 you keep snowballing: every all-in he can't escape, and a landed Q into E-AA combo trades enormously in your favor since he has no dash or blink to reset the fight.
edits.after: This lane is miserable for Aurelion Sol from level 1 — Breath of Light is a 750-range channel that needs him standing still, and Diana's dash-in kit closes that gap instantly. Through levels 3-5 you keep snowballing: he cannot escape an all-in without Astral Flight, and even that is 22 seconds, so a landed Q into E-AA combo trades enormously in your favour.

edits.before: Level 6 only widens the gap. Moonfall gives you a guaranteed gap-close onto a champion who already couldn't create space in lane, and his ultimate is a global teleport/damage tool, not a defensive escape — it does nothing to save him from a committed dive. You should be looking to end the lane outright or roam off the lead you've built.
edits.after: Level 6 only widens the gap. Moonfall gives you a guaranteed gap-close onto a champion who already couldn't create space in lane, and Falling Star is a 1250-range stun on 120 seconds, not a defensive escape — it does nothing to save him from a committed dive once Astral Flight is spent. Look to end the lane outright or roam off the lead.

edits.before: With any item lead you delete him in one rotation — his damage output can't match your burst plus true damage, and he still has no mobility to escape a flank. Late game he wants to sit back and use his ultimate for poke/zone control in teamfights, but if your team focuses him down or you catch him solo, Moonsilhouette guarantees the kill.
edits.after: With any item lead you delete him in one rotation — his damage output can't match your burst, and he still has no blink to escape a flank. Late game he wants to zone with Singularity and land Falling Star from 1250 range, but stay above the execute threshold at its centre and he has no answer when you catch him alone.

notes:
FABRICATED ABILITY NAMES: the content layer was written on Aurelion Sol's PRE-REWORK kit — 'comet orbit', 'Starsurge' and 'Voice of Light' appear across spikes[0..2], wants.you[1], wants.foe[0] and early. None exist. All replaced with Breath of Light, Astral Flight, Singularity and Falling Star, and the advice rebuilt on the real mechanics rather than just swapping the words.
content mid also called Falling Star 'a global teleport/damage tool' (it is a 1250-range stun on 120s) and content late credited Diana with true damage, which no Diana ability has. Both corrected.
CHART: four full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart, both unanimously Diana — including phases[6], which handed the last row to Aurelion Sol while its own why described Diana diving. Sides moved onto the existing win[] values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible (before would equal after and be refused). phases[0], [2] and [3].why rewritten in the same proposal.
phases[2].why on disk was garbled ('E pull joins... no —'), a template leak. Replaced.
REPORT: no report[] entry is lint-flagged or names a fabricated ability, so none was rewritten.
NOT ASSERTED: both Breath of Light and Astral Flight carry the 'channel: interruptible' flag, and Diana's only CC is Moonfall's draw-in. Whether Moonfall actually cancels Astral Flight mid-flight is not decidable from the kit text, so I wrote only that Breath of Light is a channel your arrival breaks, and made no claim about interrupting the flight.
